independent_variable: Presence versus absence of the frozen bounded typed/directed relational overlay while source, exposed diagnostics, unstructured memory, model, response grammar, budgets, seed, and acceptance rule remain fixed.

generation.policy_language: stoe.selection_policy version 1 inert JSON compiled from operator-specific fixed tables

gates.proposal: Dynamic exact keys for every exposed failed diagnostic, exact observed selections and misses, bounded enumerated mechanism IDs, and no additional fields.
gates.policy: Operator-specific bounded fixed tables compile through trusted code to an inert validated selection policy.
gates.public: Strict disclosed-diagnostic improvement with no regression.
gates.hidden: Strict total improvement over active, preserve every active pass, no critical failure, completed evaluation.
gates.activation: Unique eligible leader by targeted then total passes; tie means no activation and no SToE preference.

analysis.success_criterion: At least +2/8 targeted with no control loss
analysis.claim_limit: One paired pipeline run on twelve independent unseen cases is preliminary mechanism evidence only.
